reference: BUILD_VERIFICATION.md: historical Windows exceptions; review current diagnostics before acceptance

failures.name: VU0 macro mappings cover all S1/S2 enums
failures.reason: Test environment: reads `instructions.h` relative to the working directory (fails upstream too)

failures.name: VU random helpers emit line comments on separate lines
failures.reason: VRNEXT/VRINIT/VRXOR were rewritten as PCSX2's LFSR; the test looks for comment text of upstream's old implementation

failures.name: unresolved JALR marks internal labels as indirect fallback resume entries
failures.reason: Performance: only return addresses of indirect calls become entries (41)

failures.name: GIF PACKED A+D writes DISPFB1 and DISPLAY1 privileged registers
failures.reason: Hardware: A+D addresses 0x59–0x5F are not GS registers (33)

failures.name: GIF PACKED A+D writes DISPFB2 and DISPLAY2 privileged registers
failures.reason: Hardware: A+D addresses 0x59–0x5F are not GS registers (33)

failures.name: GS CSR/IMR support coherent 64-bit and 32-bit access
failures.reason: Hardware: CSR event bits are write-1-to-clear, FIELD/FIFO read-only

failures.name: sceGsSyncV resumes through the scheduler with deterministic field parity
failures.reason: Reads the original game's libgraph record at a fixed address (IMPROVEMENTS.md §12)

failures.name: sceGsSyncVCallback runs as a scheduler invocation on its callback stack
failures.reason: Handler stacks moved below the ELF so they no longer overwrite game stacks (14, 137)

failures.name: GIF DMA chain IRQ stops only when TIE is set
failures.reason: PCSX2: GIF state persists across transfers; the test reuses one instance

failures.name: GIF arbiter prioritizes PATH1 then PATH2 then PATH3
failures.reason: Deliberate (upstream #299): submission order, so texture uploads precede their draws; `DOD_GIF_PRIORITY_SORT=1` restores sorting (73)

failures.name: VIF FBRST RST clears VIF1 command state
failures.reason: PCSX2: RST does not clear CYCLE/MODE/NUM/MARK (102)

failures.name: VIF STMOD offset and difference modes apply to UNPACK data
failures.reason: PCSX2: the test never sets STCYCL, and CYCLE=0 unpacks nothing (43)

failures.name: VIF UNPACK V4-16 sign and zero extension follow immediate bit14
failures.reason: PCSX2: the test never sets STCYCL, and CYCLE=0 unpacks nothing (43)

failures.name: VIF UNPACK bit15 adds TOPS to destination address
failures.reason: PCSX2: the test never sets STCYCL, and CYCLE=0 unpacks nothing (43)

failures.name: VIF UNPACK num zero uploads 256 vectors
failures.reason: PCSX2: the test never sets STCYCL, and CYCLE=0 unpacks nothing (43)

failures.name: VIF masked UNPACK uses data row col and protect selectors
failures.reason: PCSX2: the test never sets STCYCL, and CYCLE=0 unpacks nothing (43)

failures.name: VIF1 DIRECT finds an image continuation after packed setup
failures.reason: Hardware: data outside a DIRECT's declared size is the next VIFcode (104)

failures.name: VIF1 DIRECT image tag can continue with raw image qwords
failures.reason: Hardware: data outside a DIRECT's declared size is the next VIFcode (104)

failures.name: VIF1 packet builders keep chain qwc live before terminate
failures.reason: Original SDK: libvifpk adds the QWC once when the packet is closed (113)

failures.name: IPU init executes its guest helper as a scheduler invocation
failures.reason: PCSX2 IPU: IPU_CTRL.RST triggers a reset and does not read back (29, 54)

failures.name: IPU init skips missing optional helper instead of dispatching the default trap
failures.reason: PCSX2 IPU: IPU_CTRL.RST triggers a reset and does not read back (29, 54)

failures.name: thread lifecycle, nested suspend, WAIT-SUSPEND, and wakeup count are centralized
failures.reason: Hardware: SuspendThread returns the thread id (64)

failures.name: SifInitRpc does not reset the running IOP
failures.reason: Performance: the IOP runs in 4096-cycle quanta on its own thread (77, 78); the test advances 80 cycles

failures.name: SifCallRpc falls back to stack ABI when register pack is implausible
failures.reason: A blocking sceSifCallRpc sleeps the caller through the scheduler as on hardware (16); the test has no scheduler loop

failures.name: register bind call updates descriptors and payload
failures.reason: A blocking sceSifCallRpc sleeps the caller through the scheduler as on hardware (16); the test has no scheduler loop
